activitysource-listener-sampling-contrac.title: Understand ActivitySource listener and sampling behavior
activitysource-listener-sampling-contrac.short: Write instrumentation assuming StartActivity can return null
activitysource-listener-sampling-contrac.summary: ActivitySource creates an Activity according to listener presence and sampling decisions, so a recorded activity does not exist for every operation.
activitysource-listener-sampling-contrac.why: Making application behavior depend on instrumentation can change semantics on unsampled paths and can add unnecessary work.
activitysource-listener-sampling-contrac.tips: Treat Activity as nullable, defer expensive tag construction until recording is needed, and keep sampling policy in listeners.

utf8jsonreader-streaming-state.title: Parse segmented JSON with Utf8JsonReader
utf8jsonreader-streaming-state.short: Carry incomplete input and JsonReaderState into the next buffer
utf8jsonreader-streaming-state.summary: Utf8JsonReader is a low-level ref-struct JSON reader; segmented input requires preserving unconsumed bytes and JsonReaderState between buffers.
utf8jsonreader-streaming-state.why: Assuming a complete JSON document arrives in one read breaks when network or pipe buffers split a token.
utf8jsonreader-streaming-state.tips: Consume through BytesConsumed, retain the remainder, carry CurrentState forward, and set isFinalBlock correctly.

channel-completion-error-propagation.title: Propagate producer failures through Channel completion
channel-completion-error-propagation.short: Do not leave consumers waiting when a producer fails
channel-completion-error-propagation.summary: Producer/consumer designs using Channel should signal both successful completion and producer exceptions through the writer completion path.
channel-completion-error-propagation.why: A fire-and-forget producer that exits on an exception without completing the writer can leave consumers waiting indefinitely.
channel-completion-error-propagation.tips: Give ownership of completion to the producer, complete with the failure when appropriate, and also observe the producer Task.

assemblyloadcontext-collectible-unload-l.title: Collectible AssemblyLoadContext unloading depends on reference lifetime
assemblyloadcontext-collectible-unload-l.short: Distinguish requesting unload from actual collection
assemblyloadcontext-collectible-unload-l.summary: Calling Unload on a collectible AssemblyLoadContext makes it eligible for unloading, but references to loaded types or objects can keep it alive.
assemblyloadcontext-collectible-unload-l.why: Events, statics, delegates, or threads that retain plugin objects can keep old assemblies resident after a plugin update.
assemblyloadcontext-collectible-unload-l.tips: Keep host/plugin reference boundaries narrow, unsubscribe events, and use a WeakReference plus GC in tests when verifying unloadability.

gc-no-gc-region-budgeting.title: Use NoGCRegion as a short allocation-budgeted region
gc-no-gc-region-budgeting.short: Do not treat disabling GC as a general optimization
gc-no-gc-region-budgeting.summary: TryStartNoGCRegion starts a bounded interval intended to avoid garbage collection while staying within a specified memory budget.
gc-no-gc-region-budgeting.why: An underestimated budget or a long region can invalidate the plan, so it is not a substitute for reducing allocations generally.
gc-no-gc-region-budgeting.tips: Reserve it for measured latency-critical regions, budget from measurements, handle start failure, and pair successful starts with EndNoGCRegion.

dns-resolution-address-family-fallback.title: Do not pin a connection to the first DNS address
dns-resolution-address-family-fallback.short: Preserve fallback across IPv4 and IPv6 candidates
dns-resolution-address-family-fallback.summary: A host can resolve to multiple IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, and choosing only the first candidate can pin a connection to an unreachable route.
dns-resolution-address-family-fallback.why: DNS ordering and IPv6 reachability vary by environment, creating failures that do not reproduce on the development network.
dns-resolution-address-family-fallback.tips: Prefer connection APIs that accept the host name and perform candidate selection; custom connection logic should consider multiple candidates and time bounds.

dbdatareader-streaming-result-lifetime.title: Stream query results with DbDataReader
dbdatareader-streaming-result-lifetime.short: Consume rows without materializing the entire result set first
dbdatareader-streaming-result-lifetime.summary: DbDataReader is the core abstraction for forward result consumption and can process large query results without first building a collection containing every row.
dbdatareader-streaming-result-lifetime.why: Materializing everything into a List increases memory with result size and delays processing of the first rows.
dbdatareader-streaming-result-lifetime.tips: Scope the reader and connection to the consumption period, pass cancellation to ReadAsync, and consume only needed columns as rows arrive.

aspnetcore-request-size-limit-boundaries.title: Design ASP.NET Core request-size limits at the boundary
aspnetcore-request-size-limit-boundaries.short: Reject oversized bodies before fully consuming them
aspnetcore-request-size-limit-boundaries.summary: Request body limits can exist at server, endpoint, and multipart layers, and should be applied at a boundary appropriate for the workload.
aspnetcore-request-size-limit-boundaries.why: Checking size only after application code buffers the full body has already spent bandwidth, memory, or temporary-file resources.
aspnetcore-request-size-limit-boundaries.tips: Separate ordinary APIs from large-upload endpoints, configure intentional limits at ingress, and keep content validation as a separate layer.

unity-managed-allocation-frame-spikes.title: Prevent per-frame Unity allocations from becoming GC spikes
unity-managed-allocation-frame-spikes.short: Measure temporary LINQ and collection allocations in hot frame paths
unity-managed-allocation-frame-spikes.summary: Repeated managed allocations in Update and other high-frequency paths accumulate and can produce visible frame-time variation when GC runs.
unity-managed-allocation-frame-spikes.why: Even small allocations become significant when repeated every frame across many objects.
unity-managed-allocation-frame-spikes.tips: Use the Profiler to identify GC Alloc hot spots, reuse buffers or collections where justified, and avoid sacrificing clarity in cold paths.

reflection-type-initialization-exception.title: Treat type initialization as a separate reflection failure boundary
reflection-type-initialization-exception.short: Do not confuse static initialization failures with metadata discovery
reflection-type-initialization-exception.summary: A type can be discovered successfully through reflection while later static initialization surfaces a TypeInitializationException.
reflection-type-initialization-exception.why: Plugin discovery and dynamic activation often mix metadata inspection with execution even though these stages have different failure modes.
reflection-type-initialization-exception.tips: Put initialization-triggering operations behind a clear boundary, record InnerException, and use non-executing metadata inspection when execution is unnecessary.
